source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Corvette Body, p.1B-6

procedures.title: Windshield: remove and install
steps: Load the caulking into the cartridge (see figure 17 in the manual).
Run one smooth unbroken bead on the inside face of the glass next to the edge, all the way around (see figure 18 in the manual): about 1/4 inch wide at the base, shaped as a 3/8 inch tall pyramid.
If the bead slumps, pause about 2-3 minutes to let it firm up; if you hit an air bubble, back the gun up and add enough material to fill the void before going on.
The reveal molding clips self-seal; no sealer is needed on them before setting the glass.
With a helper, lower the glass onto the spacers, lining up the marks on the glass and frame (see figure 19 in the manual).
Press the glass lightly to seat the caulking against the opening flanges; paddle the material where needed for a full seal.
Water-test right away with a cold water spray; paddle caulking into any leak with a flat screwdriver or stick, preferably working from inside the car.
Reinstall trim in this order: upper reveal molding, side reveal molding, side retainer molding, lower corner reveal molding, windshield pillar weatherstrip.
notes: Caution: never aim a heavy water stream straight at the caulking while it is still soft.
Figure 5 in the manual (cowl area trim) is on this page: instrument panel pad L.H., side trim panels L.H./R.H., dash panel pad R.H., J nut, screws and special washers.
